description: 1N60 point-contact germanium diode: a very soft, low clipper (our fit to Wuxi Xuyang's sheet)

source.licence: Our own fit to the maker's datasheet curve (D-156): the values are Solum Builder's

rating_sources.if_avg: Wuxi Xuyang Electronic 1N60P/1N60 data sheet, rev. b (Point Contact Germanium Diodes), Absolute Maximum Ratings: average rectified output current 50 mA
rating_sources.vr_max: Wuxi Xuyang Electronic 1N60P/1N60 data sheet, rev. b (Point Contact Germanium Diodes), Absolute Maximum Ratings: reverse voltage dc 20 V

fit.sheet: Wuxi Xuyang Electronic 1N60P/1N60 data sheet, rev. b (Point Contact Germanium Diodes)
fit.figure: Forward Characteristics (page 2), read from the PDF's vector drawing
fit.method: IS, N and RS by least squares on V = N·Vt·ln(I/IS) + RS·I (scripts/fit_models.py fit_diode, Vt at 27 °C) over every other curve point; IS held at 50 µA, half the sheet's 100 µA reverse-current limit at 10 V (IS is the model's reverse current): left free it came out at 118 µA, over the limit, while held at 50 µA the held-out points stay within 44 mV. The sheet's typical reverse curve reads about 5 µA at 10 V, so the model leaks more than a typical unit; CJO is the sheet's 1 pF maximum at −1 V; EG 0.67 eV (germanium); BV 45 V, the peak reverse voltage
fit.note: The figure is linear and starts at 0.8 mA, so below that the fit follows the diode equation, not the sheet. A crude, soft curve (N 4.3): a point-contact part, and the sheet's own drawing

package.name: Axial glass
package.source: Wuxi Xuyang 1N60P/1N60 data sheet, rev. b (names no outline; point-contact glass); pins numbered by KiCad's convention, 1 cathode, 2 anode: the sheet doesn't number the leads (the user, 2026-10-29, D-159). The band marks the cathode
